services.name: Yuletide River Cruise
services.desc: A festive holiday boat tour along the Banana River featuring twinkling Christmas lights, hot cocoa, holiday music. Wear your best holiday garb for this holiday-themed event! Please register by December 10. AD and Families: $2pp - all others $10pp Read

services.name: Tubing with ODR
services.desc: Strap in and hit the water! Speed across the marina, splash around, and enjoy a thrilling tubing adventure the whole family will love. Must be at least 8 years old and able to swim. - Saturday, September 26, 1-6PM - Time slots from 1-3PM and 4-6PM - Please register by September 24 - AD and sponsored Families $2 pp;
